source: Recording Information: unknown stereo(?) recording equipment -> master AUD cassette (NOT a SBD as noted in shnid 9770) -> ? -> unknown generation tape used for shnid 9770 -> CDr > EAC > Soundforge (normalize & pitch correction -> shn -> aiff (xACT) -> flacs; flacs -> TLH -> wavs -> Audacity using right channel for mono signal [fades, manual one-at-a-time glitch, bump, pop, click, dropout & dullspot repairs, volume adjustments, NO equalisation] -> CD Wave (track splits) -> flacs (Trader's Little Helper)

ai_review.summary: Low‑grade recording of an incomplete show, offering little listening value
ai_review.review: The single review characterizes this tape as a low‑quality capture of a show that is not even complete. With no mention of any strong musical moments and the recording described as subpar, listeners are unlikely to find it satisfying.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one brief, low‑star review; both performance (incomplete) and recording quality (poor) are judged negatively, leading to a rating around two stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as a low‑grade recording; likely suffers from clarity issues and missing portions of the concert.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show is incomplete, with parts omitted, making the overall flow fragmented.
